name: anothernotes-desktop
description: AnotherNotes for the desktop: the web app in a window of its own.
author: AnotherNotes

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish always --config electron-builder.config.cjs
